headline: Pixel 11 specs and price leak with no surprises
summary: Leaked Pixel 11 specs and price align with previous rumors. The Pixel 11 is expected to see a $100 price hike. It will reportedly start at $899 with 256GB storage.

headline: Angela Nissel faces down grief with a laugh
summary: Angela Nissel's new memoir, "Good Grief, Pass the Bread, Mom Is Dead," combines emotion and humor. The book explores caring for a terminally ill parent with gallows humor. It offers a unique perspective on dealing with tough times.

headline: Is this Billboard Hot 100 hit AI slop?
summary: Fenix Flexin's solo track "Rubberz" hit number 58 on the Billboard Hot 100. Speculation quickly arose about the song's origins. Many believe the track was largely generated by AI.

headline: Spider-Man: Brand New Day leak racks up millions of views
summary: A bootleg of "Spider-Man: Brand New Day" was leaked on X for over seven hours. The leak amassed 5.9 million views and 143,000 likes before being pulled. Disney is now actively removing reposts of the film.

headline: Spider-Man: Brand New Day Beats Avengers: Endgame Record to Claim Biggest Domestic Opening Day of All Time
summary: Spider-Man: Brand New Day shattered box office records on its opening day. It earned a staggering $168 million domestically. The film surpassed Avengers: Endgame for the biggest opening day ever.

headline: Game of Thrones: The Mad King Reveals Full Stage Cast and First Portrait
summary: The Game of Thrones: The Mad King stage play unveiled its full cast. A first official cast photo was released. Key characters like King Aerys II and Young Ned Stark are featured.

headline: Vincent Pastore, The Sopranos Actor, Dies at 80
summary: Vincent Pastore, known for The Sopranos, has passed away. He was 80 years old. Pastore played Salvatore Bonpensiero in the iconic TV series.

headline: Elden Ring Players Are Hoping for Godwyn DLC After FromSoftware Shares Cryptic Social Media Post
summary: FromSoftware posted a cryptic social media message. Elden Ring fans speculate it hints at new Godwyn DLC. This follows two years after the Shadow of the Erdtree expansion.

headline: Trump says he is cancelling strikes on Iran subject to deal being made 'rapidly'
summary: Trump announced he's cancelling strikes on Iran. This is conditional on a deal being made rapidly. He claims Iran and other nations requested a halt to attacks.

headline: Three killed after bomb detonated at Moscow restaurant, state media say
summary: A bomb detonated at a Moscow restaurant, killing three. A woman was stopped trying to enter with explosives. Security guards prevented her full entry, but the bomb still detonated.

headline: Young guns for hire - the teenage hitmen recruited to kill across Europe
summary: The Foxtrot Network employs teenage hitmen across Europe. The network is linked to approximately 35 murders. They operate using "violence-as-a-service" tactics.

headline: A bruising 24 hours - what next for Fifa and under-pressure Infantino?
summary: FIFA President Gianni Infantino faces growing pressure. His leadership is questioned after the World Cup investment plan collapsed. His future as FIFA president is now uncertain.
